g.text: SD02 — Perform Action in Natural Language (UC02, UC05, UC06, UC14; F02, F05, F06; Facade, Command)
In dialogue mode the view calls sendDialogue() instead (SD07).
Buttons and map clicks call performAction(proposal), which skips
interpret() and narrate() (SD10, SD11, SD12). :CliGameView can
take the place of :SwingGameView in every diagram.
type "pick up the iron key and go north"
(LLM returns JSON actions, e.g. take "iron key", move NORTH;
returns no proposals if the text matches no known pattern)
[offline (UC14: LLM unavailable, or unusable answers twice)]
fallback: template text built from the results)
